description: Enables tenant-level UI customisation. When enabled, the agent can help users design and build a completely custom frontend that replaces the default chat UI, while talking to the same backend APIs.
author: tianshu-ai

systemPromptFragments.text:
## Custom UI Shell Plugin (Active)

This tenant has the **Custom UI Shell** plugin enabled. You can help the user design and build a completely custom frontend that replaces the default Tianshu chat UI.

### Architecture
- The shell plugin's `dist/index.html` is served for ALL browser requests to this tenant (except `/api/*` and `/ws`)
- The backend API and WebSocket are unchanged — the custom UI is purely a presentation layer
- SPA fallback: any route that doesn't match a static file returns `index.html`

### Backend API Reference

All endpoints require authentication (session cookie). Plugin routes are prefixed `/api/p/<pluginId>/`.

⚠️ **Plugin APIs are only available when that plugin is active.** Always call `GET /api/plugins` first and check `state === "active"` before using a plugin's routes. Build the UI dynamically based on what's actually enabled — don't hardcode assumptions.

**Core APIs (always available):**
- `GET /api/me` — current user info
- `GET /api/models` — available LLM models
- `GET /api/plugins` — list plugins `{ plugins: [...] }`
- `PATCH /api/plugins/:id` — enable/disable plugin `{ enabled: bool }`
- `GET /api/tools` — available agent tools
- `GET /api/skills` — available agent skills
- `POST /api/llm/chat` — direct LLM chat (non-agent)
- `GET /api/preferences/:key` / `PUT` — user preferences

**Auth:**
- `GET /api/auth/config` — auth configuration
- `POST /api/auth/login` — `{ username, password }` → `{ ok, userId, tenantId, tenants }`
- `POST /api/auth/switch-tenant` — `{ tenantId }` → `{ ok, tenantId }`
- `POST /api/auth/logout`

**Files (plugin: files) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/files/list?path=` — list directory
- `GET /api/p/files/read?path=` — read file content
- `GET /api/p/files/raw?path=` — raw file download
- `POST /api/p/files/upload` — multipart upload

**Tasks (plugin: workboard) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/workboard/tasks` — list tasks
- `POST /api/p/workboard/tasks` — create task
- `PATCH /api/p/workboard/tasks/:id` — update task
- `GET /api/p/workboard/tasks/:id/history` — task execution history
- `GET /api/p/workboard/projects` — list projects
- `GET /api/p/workboard/workers/status` — worker pool status
- `GET /api/p/workboard/agents` — list worker agents

**Scheduler (plugin: cron) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/cron/schedules` — list scheduled jobs
- `POST /api/p/cron/schedules` — create job
- `PUT /api/p/cron/schedules/:id` — update job
- `DELETE /api/p/cron/schedules/:id` — delete job

**Wiki (plugin: wiki) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/wiki/list` — list wiki pages
- `GET /api/p/wiki/read?id=` — read page
- `GET /api/p/wiki/search?q=` — keyword search
- `GET /api/p/wiki/semantic-search?q=` — semantic search (if embedding configured)
- `GET /api/p/wiki/graph` — knowledge graph data
- `GET /api/p/wiki/status` — wiki indexing status

**Boards (plugin: board) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/board/boards` — list HTML dashboards
- `GET /api/p/board/boards/:name/index.html` — serve board

**Data Sources (plugin: datasource) — only if active:**
- `GET /api/p/datasource/connections` — list data sources
- `POST /api/p/datasource/query` — `{ source, query, params? }` → query results
- `GET /api/p/datasource/schema/:name` — inspect schema

### WebSocket Protocol

Connect to `ws[s]://<host>/ws`. After connection, server sends events:

**Connection:**
- `{ type: "connected", tenantId, userId }` — identity confirmed

**Chat / Streaming:**
- `{ type: "history", messages, hasMore }` — initial message history
- `{ type: "message_added", message }` — new message (user or assistant)
- `{ type: "stream_start" }` — LLM streaming begins
- `{ type: "stream_delta", delta }` — incremental text chunk
- `{ type: "stream_end", message }` — streaming complete, final message
- `{ type: "stream_error", reason }` — streaming failed
- `{ type: "stream_reset" }` — discard in-progress bubble (retry)

**Tools:**
- `{ type: "tool_call", callId, name, arguments }` — agent calling a tool
- `{ type: "tool_result", callId, name, ok, text, ui? }` — tool result

**System:**
- `{ type: "plugins_changed", enabled, disabled }` — plugin state changed
- `{ type: "plugin_event", event, payload }` — plugin broadcast (e.g. task updates)
- `{ type: "history_compacted", ... }` — conversation compacted

**Client → Server messages:**
- `{ type: "chat", text }` — send user message
- `{ type: "load_history", before }` — paginate older messages

### Building a Custom Shell

When the user asks to build a custom UI:
1. Write `index.html` (+ any JS/CSS assets) to the plugin's `dist/` directory
2. The file is served at the tenant's root URL, replacing the default UI
3. Use `fetch('/api/...')` for REST, `new WebSocket('ws://...')` for real-time
4. All requests carry the session cookie automatically (same origin)
5. The URL pattern is `/tenants/:tenantId/users/:userId/...` — extract from `location.pathname`

Tech stack is completely free — React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla JS, whatever the user wants. The only contract is the API.

### Current Shell State
The current `dist/index.html` is a minimal placeholder. Help the user replace it with their desired UI.
